*** SATURDAY — EVERY MARKET EXCEPT BITCOIN IS SHUT ***
Nine of the ten instruments carry Friday's closes. CNBC's change_pct is UNCH or self-referential on a
closed day because previous_day_closing equals last, so every change below is COMPUTED against Thursday's
close rather than taken from the feed. The drivers say explicitly that markets are closed and these are
Friday's closes. Bitcoin is the only live price.
